- Open semantic values crossing boundaries use owner-named checked brands.
- Closed vocabularies use named Schema.Literal/Literals and Match.
- Human/generated content, transport strings, secrets, and diagnostics use owner-named checked Schemas where exported/cross-boundary, not mechanical brands.
